Lagna minute-prediction gates on the sub lord alone and never reads the star lord

An electional event was named from a misread heading, so partnership meetings elected on scholarship-letter houses

Mars Dosha used one reference point of three and counted houses where the corpus says signs
KSK's replacement for Mars Dosha is implemented, and its raw form fires on 100% of charts
The engine could say whether marriage is promised and when, and nothing about why it is late
The spouse description was read from a planet the corpus never names, on the authority of a file that does not exist
The four-level order is corpus-confirmed, its conditional on L2 and L4 is now settled and implemented, and the two uncited weight tables are unified
bunfig.toml set a 30s test timeout, bun test ignored it silently, and CI has been running at 5s
The querent's horary number is computed, reported, and then discarded. It never reaches the chart.
The level weight table is declared 23 times, and the file that says it is the only one is wrong

The hospitalization house group carried the cure house and dropped the body

The Four Step Theory was credited to Hariharan on four surfaces; it is Sunil Gondhalekar's

The promise verdict denied on ONE denial house, on a rule no corpus page states
Chronic Illness carried the body house in its denial group and an electional cure set as its negation
The event resolver matched inside a word, so "employment" resolved to Unemployment
career_possible was decided by the obstruction houses and never read the career houses it computed

Job Loss / Termination carried the general loss triad, not the end-of-service group
normalize360 was not the identity for in-range values, and KP decides on boundaries
Ashtakavarga is computed in houses and read as signs, so 93.6% of its sign scores are wrong
Shadbala ships the six classical names over six invented 0-100 scores, and one of them is inverted
Vimsopaka drops two of the sixteen vargas and scores the rest on an invented dignity ladder
Kemadruma is structurally unreportable, its cancellation fires on 100% of charts that reach it
Chara dasha runs zodiacally for every chart, and the karaka scheme calls a live dispute "the authentic method"
Two of fifteen saham formulas are attested, one of those disagrees with the engine, and Yasas admits its own substitution
Parivartana is classified by the houses the planets occupy, where Phaladeepika classifies by the houses they own
Graha yuddha names the winner by dignity and lower longitude, where Brihat Samhita names it by latitude
Kalsarpa ships as a Severe dosha with named remedies, and no classical text contains it
The weather family blends three traditions under one absent citation and ships all four tools tagged kp
The weather verdict's rain and drought house sets match no stated convention, and put the 6th on the dry side
The coverage ladder issued DENIED on an invented threshold, for a cuspal sub lord that does reach the required group
Business Start read two cusps and took the weaker, where KSK names the 7th cusp sub lord and the houses 2, 7 and 10
The star-lord denial route is the cuspal sub lord's own significations counted twice, and where it is not, it reaches two stellar hops above the cusp
The oncology promise is gated on an invented star-lord "cure bias", and the comment says so
KP states a grammar for building a denial group, and 71 of the 78 event rows do not follow it
The nakshatra was recomputed from the longitude instead of read off the row, and contradicted its own star lord on 9 of the 249 horary numbers
"\"Stationary\" was an invented state with three incompatible definitions, and the question KP actually asks, when does the planet turn direct, had no answer at all"
Every audit script subtracted the UTC offset twice, so the 48-chart spread was never the spread it named
Two of the fifteen sahams were byte-identical to two others, so the tool returned thirteen points under fifteen names
KP does not discard dignity and combustion, it moves them to the constellation lord, and the engine implements neither the discard nor the replacement
The Moon and every house cusp sat on the mean equinox while the Sun and planets sat on the true one, up to 18.8 arcseconds apart in the same chart
KSK's own printed ayanamsa table is two straight segments about 2 arcminutes apart, and the base Q005 pinned came from software rather than the page
The fruitful-significator compactor deleted the Ruling Planet roles and the C4 tiebreak rank on the way to every MCP caller
Five more compactors were deleting KP claims on the wire, all caught the day the golden-payload test existed
The planets sat up to ten arcminutes off the JPL lineage, from truncated tables, no light-time, and the Sun's aberration applied to planets
The "true" lunar node was Meeus's five-term approximation, up to twelve arcminutes from the osculating node, under a comment claiming one arcsecond
The 78 event rows gain their pages; 16 shipped a group no page states and are corrected from the corpus, moving 12.0% of verdicts
The engine offers six ayanamsas and computes five, because true_chitra is routed to the Lahiri function
The paradigm panel read KP's definitions of house lord AND house placement and labelled them Parashari
Ten non-KP modules judge houses by the Placidus bhava, and a kendra flips 27% of the time
Module headers mix printed and canon page numbers with no label, and one page number is wrong under both
The engine's Lahiri sits 14 to 15 arcseconds from Swiss Ephemeris's Lahiri, and had no external oracle until Spica arrived
The eclipse screen misses every penumbral lunar eclipse (7 of 26 in 2000 to 2010) and passes one non-eclipse in 25 solar syzygies
Ashtottari and Yogini start the wrong lord, carry no balance at birth, and hand the wall clock in as UTC
The combustion grades use a per-planet table where Reader 1 prints one flat three-band rule, and the two disagree on 2.58% of planet rows
get_mantra_recommendation names three loci and none carries a mantra rule, while the page that does discuss propitiation refuses it
BPHS 27.34-36's Chesta minimum, as transmitted, sits above Chesta bala's own maximum, so no chart can pass that gate
KP's aspect orb table and its moiety rule are the Tajik deeptamsa doctrine, and one of its seven values is probably a damaged digit
The varshaphala year lord is the annual lagna lord taken unconditionally, and only the file header claims otherwise
Patyayini was never blocked on panchavargeeya bala, and four documents said it was
get_multi_system_verdict's documented house_group path never worked, and omitting the optional event returned a 500
